description: This file defines the view for a subpanel that manages prospect lists within the SuiteCRM module, generating HTML forms and UI elements for listing and adding prospect lists related to campaigns or other modules.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering list views in the SuiteCRM framework, managing templates and data display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the template for the list view, pointing to the HTML template and language strings.

methods.name: xTemplateAssign
methods.description: Assigns variables to the XTemplate used for rendering the view.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title of the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderText
methods.description: Sets the header text, often including action buttons or links.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view with provided data.
